name: neleceni
description: Chrome extension that mutes a YouTube stream while a chosen speaker holds the floor, by reading the on-screen name caption.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f neleceni-*.zip && cd dist && zip -qrX ../neleceni-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '.*' && cd .. && echo "Wrote neleceni-$npm_package_version.zip"
